newsitem.title: USA: McWhorter sees modest 2nd half growth.
newsitem.headline: McWhorter sees modest 2nd half growth.

text.p: McWhorter Technologies Inc said Tuesday it expects modest volume growth for the rest of 1997, with full-year volume meeting its expectations.
"We are pleased with our volume growth in the first half," John Stevenson, chairman, said in a statement.
Volume increased nine percent in the second quarter and 11 percent for the half compared with a year ago, he said.
"Although the second half of 1997 will be a more difficult comparison, we are anticipating modest growth for the rest of the year and meeting our full-year volume expectations," Stevenson said.
McWhorter, which makes resins, today reported higher second quarter and first half earnings.
